artworks.title: The Virgin Immaculate
artworks.medium: black chalk heightened with white on blue paper
artworks.description: The image shows a full-figure drawing of a person standing upright with hands crossed over the chest. The individual's face is visible, framed by long hair partly hidden under a flowing garment, likely a robe with a hood or veil. The person is dressed in full-length attire with ample drapery indicating folds typical of classical robes. Surrounding the figure are outlines of clouds with ethereal beings, potentially angels or cherubs, some carrying instruments like swords. Above the central figure is a dove, possibly in flight. The background includes cloud-like shapes blending with the figures, creating a celestial theme.

artworks.title: Two Nudes in a Forest
artworks.medium: colored crayon drawing on white wove paper

artworks.title: A Rocky Shore at Coombmartin, Devon (Combe Martin Bay)
artworks.medium: pen and gray-brown ink and wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape view from a slightly elevated perspective. In the foreground, there is calm water with a small boat and figures. In the background, there are rocky cliffs, hills, a path, and a few structures among trees. Rolling hills lead to the horizon, meeting the sky. The artwork features delicate and precise brushstrokes, defining textures of rocks and foliage. Ink washes suggest contours and lighting. The color palette includes shades of gray and muted earth tones, creating a serene visual effect.

artworks.title: Holy Family with Putti
artworks.description: This is a drawing of cherubic figures in a natural and architectural setting. The scene shows small, winged, cherub-like figures playing among trees and architectural elements like a column. They interact with a large cornucopia filled with fruits. Some cherubs climb or hang from a garland around the column. In the background are trees and a vast landscape extending into the distance, with birds flying in the sky. The composition is detailed, conveying movement and energy.

artworks.title: The Massacre of the Innocents, Second Plate
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a chaotic scene in a classical architectural setting. The image shows a wide street lined with grand buildings featuring arches and columns. In the foreground, numerous figures are engaged in dynamic activities, spread out across the street. The middle ground and background also depict a frenzied atmosphere, leading to distant architecture and a sky filled with fine lines representing clouds. The composition is detailed and lively, with intricate lines contributing to the energetic atmosphere.

artworks.title: Storm-Tossed Ships Wrecked on a Rocky Coast
The Infant Bacchus Astride a Wine Barrel
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a cherubic figure seated on a wine barrel. The figure is depicted as a nude cherub or putto, sitting on a large wine barrel. It has a band of ivy or grapevines draped over its body, holding a horn in one hand and a staff entwined with vines in the other. The barrel has a spigot at the base, from which liquid is flowing. The background has vertical lines, potentially suggesting a wooden texture or paneling. The imagery conveys a sense of celebration, reminiscent of Bacchanalian themes associated with wine and revelry. The scene is detailed and finely etched in a monochrome palette, typical of traditional engravings.

artworks.title: Abraham Bloemaert
artworks.medium: engraving with woodcut tone block in ochre on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man from the chest up, depicted in a seated position facing slightly to the right. His facial features include a full beard and mustache, and his hair is wavy and combed back. He is wearing a dark, elaborately patterned garment with a high ruffled collar. Surrounding the portrait is an ornately engraved frame with decorations and the text "Abrahamus Bloemaert Pictor Gorcomius Batavus Ætat XLIIII. 1651." The background features classical motifs and artistic implements such as a palette, paintbrushes, books, and architectural elements.

artworks.title: The Constable of the Night
artworks.artist: William Dickinson after Egbert van Heemskerck
artworks.description: This is a drawing of anthropomorphic animals in a dimly lit room centered around a table with a candle. The scene depicts a gathering in a dark interior where animals with human-like bodies and facial features are engaging in various activities. The central figure, adorned with an elaborate hat and sitting at the table, appears to be in a position of authority, while others around the table are either watching or involved in conversation. The room is lit by a candle placed on the table, creating a focal point of light and casting shadows around the characters. Each animal character is dressed in period attire. The environment includes details like a jug and an open book.

artworks.title: Falls of Schaffhausen
artworks.artist: Charles-Melchior Descourtis after Friedrich Rosenberg after Johann Heinrich Troll
artworks.dimensions:
plate: 32.2 x 44.8 cm (12 11/16 x 17 5/8 in.)
overall (outer framing line): 23.6 x 32.4 cm (9 5/16 x 12 3/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ivan E. and Winifred Phillips, in memory of Neil Phillips
artworks.description: The image shows an elevated view of a landscape with a mixture of natural and man-made elements. The horizon is centrally positioned, blending into softly rolling hills and distant structures. A waterfall cascades down from the right side, with rocky outcroppings interrupting its flow. On the left, a stone building with a sloped roof stands near the water's edge. The brushstrokes are smooth, emphasizing details in the landscape and architectural elements. The color palette includes earthy tones with soft greens, browns, and grays, complemented by warm building colors. The sky is pale blue with a gentle gradient and fluffy clouds. Two figures in period clothing stand on a grassy bank, observing the scene, while a small boat with a rower floats in the calm water nearby. More structures and trees are visible in the distance, adding depth to the image.

artworks.title: Rachel, Countess of Middlesex
artworks.artist: Pierre Lombard after Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (cut within platemark): 34.2 x 24.2 cm (13 7/16 x 9 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a woman. She is seated with her upper body angled slightly to the left, with her right hand resting on a floral arrangement. Her face is turned towards the viewer, with a calm expression. Her hair is styled in curls, framing her face and falling on her shoulders. She is wearing an elegant gown with voluminous sleeves and a square neckline, adorned with a brooch and a chain around her waist. She has jewelry on, including earrings, a necklace, and a bracelet. The background features an ornate frame with intricate designs.

artworks.title: The Madonna Protecting Two Members of a Confraternity
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals. Two men are kneeling on either side of a central, standing figure. The central figure has a halo surrounding her head and appears to be wearing a crown. She has delicate facial features and is wearing an ornate robe, with her arms outstretched over the kneeling men. The two men have short, curly hair and beards, wearing long robes and looking up towards the central figure. The background is textured, resembling clouds or an ethereal setting.

artworks.title: The Annunciation
artworks.artist: Jacques de Gheyn II after Abraham Bloemaert
artworks.description: The image depicts various figures in a mystical setting. A large, winged figure gestures upwards amidst swirling clouds with cherubs. Below, a seated figure is at a desk with an open book. A dove emanates light at the center of the composition. Light and shadow are used to emphasize the encounter. Details include garment folds, cloud texture, and cherubs' expressions.

artworks.title: Sinon Deceiving the Trojans
artworks.artist: Giorgio Ghisi after Giovanni Battista Scultori
artworks.dimensions: sheet (cut to platemark): 35.9 x 47.1 cm (14 1/8 x 18 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is an illustration of soldiers and a divine apparition. The image shows soldiers on both sides of a body of water, with two central figures in the water. Soldiers on the banks point towards them with swords and shields. Above and to the right, the heavens reveal a vision of a galloping horse integrated within a cloud. The scene is set in a natural landscape with trees, rocks, and hills. The soldiers are depicted in intricate detail, showcasing ornate armor and expressive postures.

artworks.title: Clelia Crossing the Tiber
artworks.artist: Giulio Bonasone after Polidoro da Caravaggio
artworks.dimensions: sheet (cut to platemark): 30.5 x 44.2 cm (12 x 17 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of figures, horses, and trees. It depicts a group of figures in a wooded area. In the center, there is a horse ridden by two figures. Around them are more figures, some holding infants. The background shows large trees.

artworks.title: A Sunset in Ireland
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape featuring a river winding towards the horizon. A line of trees silhouettes against the sky, adding depth to the scene. The riverbank is detailed with vegetation, leading the viewer's eye into the image. The trees are depicted with delicate strokes, creating texture. The color palette consists of sepia or dark brown tones, enhancing the serene atmosphere of the etching.

artworks.title: Child Carrying a Puppy
artworks.description: The image features a child walking, with one foot forward. The child has long, flowing hair and a round face with a focused expression. They wear loose clothing and hold a large object and a small animal over their shoulder. A dog is lying in the foreground, looking up at the child. In the background, there are architectural elements resembling a castle with adults and another child nearby. The image has detailed line work, possibly an etching or sketch.

artworks.title: Fanciful Flowers and Bugs
artworks.medium: black and red chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features a central branch with stylized flowers and leaves, accompanied by several insects, including a large moth and smaller bugs. The color palette is primarily monochromatic with black and white tones, accented by light hints of beige or pink. In the upper part of the image, the branch curves diagonally from the top left to the bottom right, adorned with flowers positioned towards the top center and lower left. The large moth is seen in the upper right corner, while smaller branch structures with round buds and intricate leaf patterns are distributed around the lower and right portions. A small insect appears near the bottom center. The background of the image is light, making the complex lines and textures stand out.

artworks.title: Sir Peter Lely
artworks.artist: Isaak Beckett after Sir Peter Lely
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person. The individual is positioned slightly turned to the left with a gaze directed towards the viewer. Their facial features include a prominent nose, slightly pursed mouth, delicate eyes, and long, curly hair cascading down to the shoulders. The person is wearing a dark cloak over a white shirt visible at the neckline. No visible jewelry or objects are held. The background is a dark, neutral tone, and there is a decorative inscription in cursive style at the bottom on a light-colored panel.

artworks.title: Three Putti with a Dead Bull
artworks.medium: etching, engraving, and punch engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with a humanoid creature with the head of a bull, surrounded by two winged cherubs. The central figure has a muscular human body with the head of a bull. On either side, there are cherubic creatures with human bodies and wings. The background includes trees and plants. The drawing captures elements of mythology and folklore with detailed line work and shading.

artworks.title: At the Gate (Am Thor)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate gate with trees in the background. The scene features an elaborate wrought iron gate adorned with decorative motifs and topped with a lantern. Behind the gate, lush foliage is visible, casting shadows and creating a sense of depth. The gate is flanked by stone walls with iron railings continuing the intricate design. The setting suggests an entrance to a private garden or estate, with verdant trees visible in the distance. The entire scene is rendered in fine detail.

artworks.title: Disgrace (Schande): pl. 9
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed drawing of two women standing against a wall. Both women are upright, facing downward, with their arms crossed in front of them. The woman on the left has a shadow on the wall beside her and neatly combed hair pulled back. The woman on the right appears to have her hair covered, possibly with a headscarf. They wear long gowns with long sleeves and stand on a paved stone path. In the background is a curved wall with a darker area suggesting foliage or trees above it. Several additional figures appear to be watching from above the curved wall with detailed facial features. The setting is monochromatic.

artworks.title: In the Park (Im Park): pl.4
artworks.description: The image depicts two people in a partially visible embrace. The man is leaning downward, the woman slightly tilted backward. The man has wavy hair, and the woman has dark hair pulled back. The man is in a suit, and the woman in a light-colored gown with ruffles. They are positioned on or near a curved stone balustrade. In the background, there are dense, textured trees.

artworks.title: Siesta I: pl.3
artworks.description: The image shows a group of large crustaceans, possibly crabs, against a plain backdrop. The color scheme is grayscale, with shades of grey and off-white. The crabs are spread out on a textured surface, occupying most of the space in the composition.
